ns2:section.sectionText: The objective of this course is to familiarize students with commonly studied behavioral and physiological characteristics of fish, and to provide hands-on experience inhow these characteristics are assessed by biologists. Students will be required to collect data, communicate their findings with classmates and compile data, conduct statistical analysis, and process their findings to answer key questions from laboratory activities. Instruction for this course will take place in the classroom, laboratory, and at the Illinois Natural History Survey’s Aquatic Research Facility just south of the UIUC campus. Students will be required to arrange for transport to the facility, however if any students are unable to secure this,arrangements can be made with the instructor. There is no fee for the FBP section of NRES 285 in Fall 2017. Once all seats in the course are filled, you can add yourself to the waiting list by completing the form at http://go.illinois.edu/NRESwaitinglist.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci major(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
